productions.name: declaration
productions.syntax: declaration ::= record_type_decl | choice_type_decl | type_decl | error_decl | service_decl | function_decl | procedure_decl | task_decl ;

productions.name: task_decl
productions.syntax: task_decl ::= "task" IDENT "(" [ param_list ] ")" [ contract_block ] "is" { stmt } "end" IDENT ;

productions.name: choice_type_decl
productions.syntax: choice_type_decl ::= "choice" IDENT [ type_param_list ] "=" [ "|" ] constructor_decl { "|" constructor_decl } "end" IDENT ;

productions.name: function_decl
productions.syntax: function_decl ::= [ ffi_binding ] [ async_marker ] "function" IDENT [ type_param_list ] "(" [ param_list ] ")" "returns" return_type [ contract_block ] "is" { stmt } "end" IDENT ;

productions.name: procedure_decl
productions.syntax: procedure_decl ::= [ ffi_binding ] [ async_marker ] "procedure" IDENT [ type_param_list ] "(" [ param_list ] ")" [ contract_block ] "is" { stmt } "end" IDENT ;

productions.name: rpc_decl
productions.syntax: rpc_decl ::= "rpc" IDENT "(" IDENT ":" [ stream_marker ] type_ref ")" ":" [ stream_marker ] type_ref ;

productions.name: contract_block
productions.syntax: contract_block ::= { global_clause } { depends_clause } { modifies_clause } { requires_clause } { aborts_clause } { ensures_clause } ;

productions.name: stmt
productions.syntax: stmt ::= let_stmt | index_assign_stmt | field_assign_stmt | assign_stmt | return_stmt | abort_stmt | if_stmt | while_stmt | case_stmt | scope_stmt | check_stmt | call_stmt | parallel_stmt ;

productions.name: while_stmt
productions.syntax: while_stmt ::= "while" expr invariant_clause { invariant_clause } [ variant_clause ] "do" loop_block "end" "while" ;

productions.name: case_stmt
productions.syntax: case_stmt ::= "case" expr "is" ( case_branch { case_branch } default_branch | pattern_branch { pattern_branch } [ default_branch ] ) "end" "case" ;

productions.name: expr
productions.syntax: expr ::= logic_or | "spawn" expr [ "with" "(" spawn_attribute_list ")" ] | "for" "all" IDENT "in" logic_or ".." logic_or "=>" expr | "for" "some" IDENT "in" logic_or ".." logic_or "=>" expr ;

productions.name: equality
productions.syntax: equality ::= comparison | equality "=" comparison | equality "!=" comparison ;

productions.name: comparison
productions.syntax: comparison ::= sum | comparison "<" sum | comparison "<=" sum | comparison ">" sum | comparison ">=" sum ;

productions.name: sum
productions.syntax: sum ::= product | sum "+" product | sum "-" product ;

productions.name: product
productions.syntax: product ::= unary | product "*" unary | product "/" unary ;

productions.name: unary
productions.syntax: unary ::= atom | "await" "all" unary | "await" unary | "-" unary | "not" unary ;

productions.name: atom
productions.syntax: atom ::= STRING_LITERAL | DOUBLE_LITERAL | INTEGER_LITERAL | "true" | "false" | "success" | "failure" | "result" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "result" "[" expr "]" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "result" "[" expr "]" | "result" | "value" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "value" "[" expr "]" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "value" "[" expr "]" | "error" "." IDENT { "." IDENT } | "value" | "error" | array_literal | type_ref "{" named_arg_list "}" | type_ref "{" [ map_entries ] "}" | type_ref "{" set_entries "}" | field_path | IDENT "[" expr "]" | IDENT type_arg_list "(" [ arg_list ] ")" "with" "invariant" expr | field_path type_arg_list "(" [ arg_list ] ")" | IDENT type_arg_list "(" [ arg_list ] ")" | qualified_name "(" [ arg_list ] ")" | IDENT | "(" expr ")" ;
